description_en: Adds a protected directory for a specified server
description_zh: 为指定服务器添加防护目录
kebab_example: aliyun sas modify-web-lock-create-config --uuid inet-123450000 --dir /home/admin/tomcat --local-backup-dir /usr/local/backup --defence-mode block --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyWebLockCreateConfig

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the request and response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server for which you want to add a protected directory.
You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain the UUID of the server
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要添加防护目录的服务器的UUID。
您可以调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取服务器的UUID
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The folder to exclude from web tamper proofing protection.
This parameter is required when the Defense mode Mode is set to blacklist pattern
parameters.help_zh:
指定无需网页防篡改防护的目录地址（即排除目录）。
防护模式Mode配置为blacklist时，您需要配置该参数
parameters.name: exclusive_dir

parameters.help_en:
The file types to exclude from web tamper proofing protection. Separate multiple file types with semicolons (;). Valid values:
php
jsp
asp
aspx
js
cgi
html
htm
xml
shtml
shtm
jpg
gif
png

This parameter is required when the Defense mode Mode is set to blacklist pattern
parameters.help_zh:
指定无需网页防篡改防护的文件类型（即排除文件的类型）。存在多个文件类型时，使用分号（;）分隔。取值：
php
jsp
asp
aspx
js

防护模式Mode配置为blacklist时，您需要配置该参数
parameters.name: exclusive_file_type

parameters.help_en: The local backup path used for secure backup of the protected directory
parameters.help_zh: 本地备份路径，用于防护目录的安全备份
parameters.name: local_backup_dir

parameters.help_en:
The protection directory mode. Valid values:
whitelist: whitelist mode. Protects only the specified directories and file types.
blacklist: blacklist mode. Protects all subdirectories, file types, and specified files under the protected directory that are not excluded
parameters.help_zh:
指定防护目录模式。取值：
whitelist：白名单模式，对添加的防护目录和文件类型进行保护。
blacklist：黑名单模式，对添加的防护目录下所有未排除的子目录、文件类型和指定文件进行保护
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The file types to protect with web tamper proofing. Separate multiple file types with semicolons (;). Valid values:
php
jsp
asp
aspx
js
cgi
html
htm
xml
shtml
shtm
jpg

This parameter is required when the Defense mode Mode is set to whitelist pattern
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要网页防篡改防护的文件类型。存在多个文件类型时，使用分号（;）分隔。取值：

防护模式Mode配置为whitelist时，您需要配置该参数
parameters.name: inclusive_file_type

parameters.help_en:
The file to exclude from web tamper proofing protection.
This parameter is required when the Defense mode Mode is set to blacklist pattern
parameters.help_zh:
指定无需开启网页防篡改防护的文件（即排除文件）。
防护模式Mode配置为blacklist时，您需要配置该参数
parameters.name: exclusive_file

parameters.help_en:
The file to protect.
This parameter is required when the Defense mode Mode is set to whitelist pattern
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要防护的文件。
防护模式Mode配置为whitelist时，您需要配置该参数
parameters.name: inclusive_file

parameters.help_en:
The defense mode. Valid values:

block: Block mode.
audit: Alert mode
parameters.help_zh:
防护模式。取值：

block：拦截
audit：告警
parameters.name: defence_mode

ConfigId.description_en: The ID of the protected directory configuration

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
